Blundstone — Known For Its Chelsea Boots — Opening Chicago Store In Wicker Park

The Australian brand will open up next to a Dr. Martens shop and nearby several other boot and shoe retailers.
by Quinn Myers 19 hours agoSeptember 24, 2026

WICKER PARK — The popular Australian boot and footwear brand Blundstone — known widely for its Chelsea boot design — is coming to Wicker Park.

Blundstone will open a brick-and-mortar shop at 1563 N. Milwaukee Ave. this fall, according to the company’s website. The storefront was previously occupied by the snowboarding gear company Burton, and before that was the longtime home of an American Apparel.

Founded in Tasmania more than 150 years ago, Blundstone has been expanding across the country since opening its first standalone United States store last year in Los Angeles.

A specific opening date was not announced. Efforts to reach the company this week for more information about the Wicker Park store were not successful.

“Visit our Blundstone Chicago Store and discover the complete range of boot styles for men, women and kids, along with accessories,” the company’s website said.

In Wicker Park, Blundstone joins a block that’s already home to a wide range of boot and footwear retailers.

Right next door is Dr. Martens, and both John Fluevog and Thursday Boot Company are in business nearby.
